SELECT JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(executions.raw_payload, ?)), ?)) AS anon_1 
FROM executions 
WHERE executions.service_id = ? ORDER BY executions.scanned_at DESC, executions.id DESC

SELECT executions.id AS executions_id, executions.execution_key AS executions_execution_key, executions.service_id AS executions_service_id, executions.service_version_id AS executions_service_version_id, executions.scanned_at AS executions_scanned_at, executions.complete AS executions_complete, executions.scan_scope AS executions_scan_scope, executions.scope_image AS executions_scope_image, executions.pipeline_url AS executions_pipeline_url, executions.commit_sha AS executions_commit_sha, executions.scanner_db_built_at AS executions_scanner_db_built_at, executions.raw_payload AS executions_raw_payload, executions.payload_digest AS executions_payload_digest 
FROM executions 
WHERE executions.id = ?

WHERE finding_observations.execution_id = ? ORDER BY finding_observations.id
